verdict.rationale: Fireworks publishes its own REST API reference with per-endpoint pages, such as Create Chat Completion, built from a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec (Gateway REST API v5.10.0) that is listed in llms.txt. The probe's 404s at the standard OpenAPI paths only show the spec lives elsewhere, at gateway.openapi.yaml. Nothing in the evidence confirms the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser 'try it' playground, runnable code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on confirmation of interactivity.
